_about: Store category and one-line description of each app (tools/make_apps_release.py adds them to apps.json). category: emulators, games, tools, productivity or education. description: at most 120 characters.

edu.bleremote.description: Control the board from a phone over Bluetooth LE: mode, level, LED, messages and a UART console

edu.dashboard.description: Live tiles and charts: Wi-Fi signal, nearby networks and BLE devices, free memory; records CSV logs

edu.life.description: Conway's Game of Life: draw cells with your finger, load patterns, watch them evolve

edu.lvgl.description: LVGL widgets, charts and an on-screen keyboard, with the app's own LVGL 9 library

edu.mandel.description: Mandelbrot timed on 1 core, 2 cores, fast internal RAM and fixed point: see what makes code fast

edu.paint.description: Paint with several fingers at once: colours, brush sizes, flood fill, undo; BMP pictures in /sd/pictures

edu.physics.description: Drop and throw balls: gravity, bounces and collisions, with an energy bar; drawn by the P4's PPA

edu.sprite.description: Fly a spaceship sprite over space: colour key, transparency, rotation and scaling by the PPA

edu.synth.description: Two-octave touch keyboard synthesizer: 5 waveforms, echo, oscilloscope and spectrum

edu.wifiremote.description: Control the board from a browser over Wi-Fi: a web page and JSON API, or its own hotspot

emu.a800.description: Atari 800 and 5200 games, disks and tapes from /sd/roms/a800

emu.arduboy.description: Arduboy and Arduboy FX games (.hex, .arduboy) from /sd/roms/arduboy

emu.col.description: ColecoVision games (.col) from /sd/roms/col; needs BIOS.col there too

emu.gba.description: Game Boy Advance games (.gba) from /sd/roms/gba (gpSP with a RISC-V JIT; optional gba_bios.bin there)

emu.genesis.description: Sega Genesis / Mega Drive games (.md, .gen, .bin) from /sd/roms/gen

emu.neogeo.description: Neo Geo games (.zip) from /sd/roms/neogeo; needs the neogeo.zip BIOS

game.doom.description: The classic shooter (PrBoom). Needs a WAD in /sd/roms/doom, e.g. the shareware doom1.wad

game.duke3d.description: Duke Nukem 3D (Chocolate Duke3D). Needs DUKE3D.GRP in /sd/roms/duke3d

game.opentyrian.description: Vertical shoot 'em up. Needs the free Tyrian 2.1 data in /sd/tyrian/data

game.quake.description: id Software's Quake. Needs id1/pak0.pak in /sd/roms/quake (shareware works)

tool.calc.description: Scientific calculator with function graphs and currency conversion (live rates)

tool.clock.description: Clock, alarms, stopwatch, timer and world clock; touch or pad

tool.files.description: File manager for the SD card: browse, copy, move, rename and delete
